regression_notes: Earlier reader-visible assertions assumed semantic preparation had already completed; they now assert source and semantic readiness separately.
The unreadable file is selected specifically from the explorer, not an identically labelled map box. Camera comparisons begin after the deliberate focus animation settles.
The stale-page test holds acknowledgement until actual next-page completion, then releases the earlier captured preview. No state/configuration is edited to rescue the outcome.
After source becomes visible early, explicit chat submissions still wait for the shared host worker; the completion assertion observes that real queue rather than assuming a completed preparation.

limits: One unprofiled deployed source-display observation per project, with installed dependencies and prepared caches; not a universal latency budget, controlled speedup comparison or cold installation. Complete semantic readiness still requires exact-input validation.
Reader-only and deployed observation journeys make no model requests. Broader GUI/TUI model interactions use scripted providers; no new live-model/local-inference/confidentiality/refinement claim.
The directory/source inventory wire contract remains legacy outside the new FileView; generic inventory/job/evidence DTOs and the rest of native schema generation remain open.
New page-read commands still share the host worker with active semantic preparation. Prepared reader queries and independent job/status materialization remain work.
Multi-megabyte history polling, deterministic versioned layout/order artifacts and duplicate/demo retirement remain part of the active migration goal.
